<script>
function initialiseClusterHover() {

  const graph = document.querySelector(
    ".clusters-page .cell-output-display svg"
  );

  if (!graph) {
    return;
  }

  const clusterClasses = [
    "c-romance",
    "c-experimental",
    "c-corpus",
    "c-clitic",
    "c-zero",
    "c-syntax",
    "c-semantics"
  ];

  const labels = graph.querySelectorAll("g.cluster-label");

  function clearClusterHighlight() {
    graph.querySelectorAll(".is-active").forEach(function(element) {
      element.classList.remove("is-active");
    });
  }


  // Move active edges above all other edges,
  // but keep them underneath the project nodes

  function bringActiveEdgesToFront() {

  const graphGroup = graph.querySelector("g.graph");

  if (!graphGroup) {
    return;
  }

  const firstNode = graphGroup.querySelector("g.node");

  if (!firstNode) {
    return;
  }

  const activeEdges = graphGroup.querySelectorAll(
    "g.cluster-edge.is-active, g.p01-edge.is-active"
  );

  activeEdges.forEach(function(edge) {
    graphGroup.insertBefore(edge, firstNode);
  });
}


  function highlightCluster(clusterClass) {

    clearClusterHighlight();

    graph.querySelectorAll("." + clusterClass).forEach(function(element) {

      if (
        element.classList.contains("cluster-project") ||
        element.classList.contains("cluster-edge") ||
        element.classList.contains("cluster-label")
      ) {
        element.classList.add("is-active");
      }

    });

    bringActiveEdgesToFront();
  }


  labels.forEach(function(label) {

    const clusterClass = clusterClasses.find(function(className) {
      return label.classList.contains(className);
    });

    if (!clusterClass) {
      return;
    }

    label.addEventListener("mouseenter", function() {
      highlightCluster(clusterClass);
    });

    label.addEventListener("mouseleave", function() {
      clearClusterHighlight();
    });

    label.addEventListener("focusin", function() {
      highlightCluster(clusterClass);
    });

    label.addEventListener("focusout", function() {
      clearClusterHighlight();
    });

  });


  // P01 hover behaviour

  const p01 = graph.querySelector("g.p01-hub");
  const p01Edges = graph.querySelectorAll("g.p01-edge");

  function highlightP01() {

    clearClusterHighlight();

    if (p01) {
      p01.classList.add("is-active");
    }

    p01Edges.forEach(function(edge) {
      edge.classList.add("is-active");
    });

    bringActiveEdgesToFront();
  }


  if (p01) {

    p01.addEventListener("mouseenter", function() {
      highlightP01();
    });

    p01.addEventListener("mouseleave", function() {
      clearClusterHighlight();
    });

    p01.addEventListener("focusin", function() {
      highlightP01();
    });

    p01.addEventListener("focusout", function() {
      clearClusterHighlight();
    });

  }

}

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    initialiseClusterHover
  );
} else {
  initialiseClusterHover();
}
</script>
